note: **2 Lenton Avenue, schedule 171 of the 1939 Register, ED letter code RMGB.** The Ashleys, still in the house the 1921 census found them in - Thomas a chauffeur in both rounds, Hilda Mary in shoes in both. New rows on people the record already holds.
